visual_brief.subject: Gemini 4 Carbon moves from a guarded rollout into paid API and enterprise access
verified_context: Google opened paid Gemini API and enterprise access for Gemini 4 Carbon after a limited defender rollout.
The introductory rate matches Gemini 4 Argon, but Google says Carbon is designed for longer specialist work and the price doubles after November 30.
Google also previews a multi-agent /swarm workflow; the release does not prove that more agents improve results.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A dense specialist core leaves a guarded assay chamber and enters several measured channels, while one calibrated diverter keeps it from flowing everywhere.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A dark carbon-like core passes from a narrow stone chamber into three measured architectural channels controlled by one sparse terracotta routing gate.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. The guarded specialist core physically crosses one terracotta routing gate into three distinct access channels, preserving the material access change and routing caution at hero and thumbnail scales.
candidate_notes.B: Rejected after comparison. The central specialist block is strong, but the ornamental branch and instrument-like selector add visual claims not needed by the story.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant and clean, but the dark core remains visually separated from the valve, weakening the transition from guarded rollout to routed availability.

crop_review.article_desktop: The guarded chamber, specialist core, terracotta router and three destination channels remain readable across the 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop preserves the dark core crossing the terracotta routing gate; the branching channels remain visible as context.
crop_review.thumbnail: The black core, terracotta gate and three pale channels remain distinct at 320px without depending on fine detail.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate follows the model and inference references through a warm paper field, a singular dark model mass, restrained stone architecture, sparse terracotta emphasis and generous negative space.
